usage: The phrase '練肌肉' is used to describe the action of training or building muscles through exercise.
'練肌肉' functions as a verb phrase and usually appears with words describing time or place, e.g., '每朝去健身室練肌肉' (go to the gym every morning to train muscles).
You can use '練肌肉' when talking about fitness routines or bodybuilding activities.
It is often used alongside terms indicating effort or frequency, like '努力練肌肉' (work hard to train muscles).
The phrase can be the main verb in a sentence or part of a compound verb phrase.
